response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), avg_fig AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.order_count) AS avg_order_count, AVG(g.order_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM gender_counts g CROSS JOIN avg_fig a WHERE g.order_count > a.avg_count;
